title: astrephia laxa
intro: Astrephia laxa, commonly known as the silky aster or lax astrephia, is a flowering plant belonging to the family Polemoniaceae. The health benefits of Astrephia laxa include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against oxidative stress. Bioactive constituents of Astrephia laxa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
